verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a first-party export of user data in open formats. Self-hosting, open-source code, Drizzle Studio database access and MCP thread retrieval are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not an export capability, and the underlying Gmail or Outlook data belongs to the host provider rather than to Zero.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
